test_register_cli_command: test the PluginContext.register_cli_command method registers a CLI command with name, help, setup_fn, handler_fn, and description
test_overwrites_on_duplicate: test that registering a duplicate CLI command name overwrites the previous entry with the new help text
test_memory_plugin_cli_discovery: test the discover_plugin_cli_commands function discovers only the active memory provider's CLI commands from cli.py files
test_handler_optional: test that register_cli_command works without a handler_fn and sets handler_fn to None when omitted
test_provider_collector_noop: test that _ProviderCollector.register_cli_command is a no-op and does not store _cli_commands
